name: Opportunity Green
summary: A UK nonprofit using law, policy and economics to cut emissions from aviation and shipping, including support for climate-vulnerable countries at the International Maritime Organization.

spending.source: Opportunity Green, Report and Financial Statements for the year ended 31 March 2026 (audited), statement of financial activities p. 26, https://register-of-charities.charitycommission.gov.uk/en/charity-search/-/charity-details/5191761/accounts-and-annual-returns: charitable activities £2,468,983 of £2,544,811 total expenditure, at the IRS 2025 yearly average rate (facts: fx.usd_per_gbp_2025, nine of the twelve months)

lines.label: Law, policy and economics for climate action (aviation and shipping emissions, climate-vulnerable countries)
lines.source: https://register-of-charities.charitycommission.gov.uk/en/charity-search/-/charity-details/5191761/accounts-and-annual-returns (accounts for the year to 31 March 2026: one charitable-activities line for all its work, shipping, aviation, legal and new sectors, covered by one model)
